summary: Konami's Rocket Knight/Sparkster platform-action series, covering the Genesis original, the Genesis and SNES follow-ups, the 2010 HD revival, and the 2024 Re-Sparked collection.

entries.title: Rocket Knight Adventures

emulation.emulator: Carbon Engine in Re-Sparked; Genesis Plus GX for owned original dumps
emulation.notes: Use Re-Sparked for the recommended playthrough; use original Genesis emulation only if comparing original presentation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive presentation with collection display options, saves, rewind, and museum extras.

primary.why: The 2024 Re-Sparked collection is the most complete official route for the original game because it adds museum/music-player extras, boss rush, saves, rewind, and display settings; PC is the best capture-friendly version among the collection platforms.
primary.how_to_play: Play Rocket Knight Adventures through Rocket Knight Adventures: Re-Sparked on Steam/PC. Use original Genesis hardware or an owned dump only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Re-Sparked is an emulated classic collection with extras, not a remake.

entries.title: Sparkster: Rocket Knight Adventures 2

emulation.emulator: Carbon Engine in Re-Sparked; Genesis Plus GX for owned original dumps
emulation.notes: Use Re-Sparked for the complete package.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Genesis/Mega Drive presentation with collection display options and rewind/save conveniences.

primary.why: Re-Sparked includes the Genesis sequel alongside the other classic Rocket Knight games and adds museum/music-player extras, boss rush, saves, rewind, and display settings; PC is the cleanest capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Sparkster: Rocket Knight Adventures 2 through Rocket Knight Adventures: Re-Sparked on Steam/PC. Use a Genesis/Mega Drive original only for cartridge comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Re-Sparked is an emulated classic collection with extras, not a remake.

entries.title: Rocket Knight

emulation.emulator: Native Windows preferred; RPCS3/Xenia only for owned console copies if needed
emulation.notes: Use native PC when available for clean capture and modern display control.

primary.why: The 2010 revival is a native HD game released on Windows, Xbox 360, and PlayStation 3; Windows is the highest-fidelity and most capture-friendly route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows version if already owned. If unavailable, Xbox 360 or PlayStation 3 digital/hardware access is the fallback.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2010 game is a new revival, not included in the 2024 Re-Sparked classic collection.
